channel.title: Interface · projectious.work brand
channel.description: The foundations applied to screens — components, code surfaces, appearances, icons, and forms.

item.title: Components
item.description: The component set as live specimens — buttons, inputs, cards, tables, navigation, feedback, overlays, and data display.

item.title: Composed patterns
item.description: How the components combine into whole screens — the page shell, the KPI row, and the primary/secondary split.

item.title: Appearances
item.description: Light, navy dark, and deep dark from one semantic token contract.

item.title: Code
item.description: The default dark code surface, optional light-panel companion, and measured syntax roles.

item.title: Iconography
item.description: Tabler outline icons on a 24 px grid, with one stroke system and semantic colour.

item.title: Forms
item.description: Input sizing, labels, focus, error, and disabled states.

item.title: States
item.description: Empty, loading, and error states — the screens a component set never shows you.

item.title: Accessibility
item.description: Keyboard order, skip links, focus management across composed layouts, and the ARIA the component set requires.
